title: AAMS announces 2026 Community Award finalists
summary: The awards are to be presented during the 2026 Air Medical Transport Conference in Fort Worth, Texas.
body_markdown:
The Association of Air Medical Services (AAMS) has announced the finalists for the 2026 Community Awards to be presented during the 2026 Air Medical Transport Conference in Fort Worth, Texas.


“Each year, we’re reminded of the extraordinary talent, innovation, and dedication that drive medical transport forward,” said Jana Williams, AAMS president and CEO.


“This year’s finalists represent the very best of our industry, and we look forward to recognizing their achievements and celebrating their impact with colleagues from across the profession in Fort Worth.”


Below are the finalists for the 2026 Community Awards:


**Program of the Year, sponsored by Airbus**


Honors an emergency medical transport service that exemplifies excellence in patient care, leadership, safety, innovation, and community impact.


**CareFlite** , Texas


**Guardian Flight Alaska, Alaska**


Hackensack Meridian Health AirMed, New Jersey


**HALO-Flight, Inc.** , Texas


**Life Flight Network** , Oregon


**LifeNet of New York** – Guthrie Air, New York


**Northwell’s SkyHealth** , New York


**UNC Health – Carolina Air Care** , North Carolina


**Marriott-Carlson Lifetime Achievement Award, sponsored by Bell**


Honors an individual for outstanding contributions to the growth, leadership, and promotion of the emergency medical transport community through active involvement.


**Thomas Allenstein** , Children’s Nebraska


**Rene Borghese,** HCA Healthcare


**Letch Day** , Air Evac Lifeteam 179


**Milton Geltz** , Metro Aviation


**Dr. Maja Lundborg-Gray** , Air Methods


**Jim Charlson Safety Award, sponsored by Life Flight Network**


Recognizes a team, organization, or individual for advancing safety in air and critical care ground transport through impactful contributions and leadership.


**Alexander Gutierrez,** PHI Air Medical


**Arron Paduaevans** , Survival Flight


**Craig Prichard** , Air Methods


**Jeff White** , HealthNet Aeromedical Services, Inc.


**Neonatal/Pediatric Transport Award of Excellence, sponsored by AirBorne**


Honors a team for exceptional contributions to neonatal/pediatric transport through leadership, safety, education, or advocacy that improves patient care.


**Children’s Mercy Critical Care Transport** , Kansas


**EastCare Children’s Transport Team** , North Carolina


**Nationwide Children’s Hospital Transport Team** , Ohio


**UNC Health’s Pediatric/Neonatal Specialty Team** , North Carolina


**Transport Mechanic Award of Excellence, sponsored by Leonardo**


Honors an individual for advancing the safe operation or maintenance of medical transport vehicles through impactful maintenance procedures.


**Jeff Dusseault** , Dartmouth Hitchcock Advanced Response Team (DHART)


**Josh King** , Dartmouth Hitchcock Advanced Response Team (DHART)


**Scott Whittingham,** Guardian Flight


**Excellence in Transport Leadership Award**


Honors a leader in air and ground critical care transport for exceptional knowledge, visionary leadership, safety, innovation, and commitment to the medical transport community.


**Betsy Casanave** , Air Methods


**Christopher Hardman** , PHI


**Danny Nayman** , ZOLL/International College of Advanced Paramedics


**Jared Sherman** , Global Medical Response


**Joseph Solda** , Hackensack Meridian Health AirMed


**Eileen Frazer Spark Award, presented in partnership with CAMTS**


Celebrates bold vision and emerging leadership in out-of-hospital care. Honors an individual early in their career whose innovative idea or initiative has the potential to reshape the medical transport landscape—echoing Eileen Frazer’s pioneering work in founding CAMTS.


**Emily Baker** , FlightBridge Ed


**Shauna Hadgraft** , UNC Health – Carolina Air Care


**Tracy Jarvis Connellan** , JEMSTAR


**Shannon Ramsey,** Life Flight Network


**Brendon Sanders** , AdventHealth


**Anna Woody** , ECU Health Maynard Children’s Hospital


The winners will be revealed Tuesday, October 27 at 3:30 pm CST at the Fort Worth Convention Center. All AMTC26 attendees are encouraged to join.


*This press release was prepared and distributed by the Association of Air Medical Services.*
